title: The Year Blogging Began
narrative: The wreckage of the crash clears and something quieter takes root. Blogging tools make publishing personal, LinkedIn makes your career a network, camera phones put a lens in every pocket, and Wi-Fi untethers the laptop. The web stops being a place you visit and starts being something you carry.
